title: anim.lint_allow/1
description: data/anim/lint_allow.json: pairs the silhouette lint does not flag and the poses it does not compare. overlay: pose-id prefixes layered over another pose and never shown alone. pairs: two poses meant to look alike, with the reason. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every pair pose is in poses.json; an overlay prefix that matches no pose is a warning) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (lint-allow-pose).

items.description: A pose-id prefix ending in a dot.
